description: Crypto token synastry (compatibility by sky geometry of two tokens, data only): the cross-aspects between two launch skies with orbs, harmonious / tense counts, the tightest aspects and a geometry score defined in the response, plus a shareable SVG card. E.g. {token_a: {launch_datetime: '2018-08-03T19:28:24Z', symbol: 'USDC'}, token_b: {launch_datetime: '2020-09-14T18:11:26Z', symbol: 'UNI'}}. Two launch moments (UTC block times) compared like a synastry, without houses: every major cross-aspect between token A's and token B's planets with its orb and exactness, harmonious (trine, sextile) / tense (square, opposition) / conjunction counts, the five tightest aspects as readable labels, and geometry_score = 100 x H / (H + T) where H and T sum the exactness (1 - orb / orb allowed) of harmonious and tense aspects -- an aggregate of geometry, defined in the response, not a rating. Rows ready for pandas; result.card.svg is a server-rendered card naming both tokens. Data only — never a signal or forecast. Deterministic (JPL DE440, no LLM); every result carries meta.result_sha256. Price $0.25 per call via REST POST https://astro-agent.dev/v1/finance/token-synastry (x402 or MPP); always paid, never a free call.
